mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235.0) signals potential monetary tightening, reducing equity market returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:Federal Reserve historical data on inflation and rate hikes
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 15800) combined with low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 235.0) indicates a healthy economic expansion that supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
